what: CORRECT seeded per-HAID checkpoint stream. The gate folds it through the impl (checkpoint_share.fold_stream) AND the independent reference (reference.fold), normalizes to served/excluded_security, and diffs. They MUST be identical. Exercises INV-C (a security slice excluded) + INV-D (a consent-off slice skipped) + INV-G (the served roster). A false-RED here means the gate rejects its own golden and is itself broken.
